title: Parked-worker regression test: bounded exit guard and deterministic early-timer coverage
outcome: parked_observation_worker_inspects_once_per_wake_and_claims_only_due_work cannot hang on a missing shutdown wake and fails if a short periodic poll is reintroduced.
acceptance: The shutdown assertion waits for a worker-exited event under the existing bounded deadlock guard before joining, and fixture cleanup releases the park on failure.
The test verifies the requested park duration through a scheduler seam or a scripted wait, so a worker that waits min(due, 100 ms) fails it deterministically.
No new assertion rests on wall-clock duration; a two-vendor review has no Medium or higher finding.
